name: hudplay
description: Sistema completo de gestão de quadras esportivas — Web + APK Android

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/web && npm run lint --workspace backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace apps/web
